name: Amare
source:
Amare is the self proclaimed genius of the underworld. Paw's dad created him, which makes him the third general to be created by the Demon Lords past. 

The dude's mad about tech and machinery, he's always looking into how things work and how he can upgrade his own inventions. Although, he can go overboard sometimes and once he does go off the deep end, he commits to it.

Once, I asked him to recreate this console I saw on earth but he made it into a flying drone that blasted lasers every time I pressed a button...I just wanted to play Wowzer's Odyssey.

- Kobu's journal entry on Amare
